commontrades.configuration.title: %s Configuration
commontrades.configuration.general.toolt: Server-authoritative gameplay settings. Remote players cannot change a server's trades from their client.
commontrades.configuration.general.enabl: Whether Common Trades adds Wandering Trader offers on this server or single-player world.
commontrades.configuration.general.extra: Target number of Common Trades offers per Wandering Trader. Vanilla selects five generic offers, so this is capped at 3.
commontrades.configuration.categories.to: Enable or disable each discovered trade category.
commontrades.configuration.pricing.toolt: Emerald costs used by server-generated Wandering Trader offers.
commontrades.configuration.blacklists.to: Server-side filters for items, mod namespaces, and item tags.
commontrades.configuration.blacklists.it: Specific item ids Common Trades must never offer.
commontrades.configuration.blacklists.mo: Mod namespaces Common Trades must never offer.
commontrades.configuration.blacklists.ta: Item tag ids whose contents Common Trades must never offer. A leading # is optional.
